visual_appeal: Hero right column: the 1.5 is the only strong mark, then a faint runner-up leaves a dead well under it. Set Then Le Bankken, full in 19h to 13px #e6d3a1, 4px under LEVELS BANKED, and vertically center that three-line stack on the 112px portrait.
The rest bar is a flat bright green slab. Make it 14px tall with a 1px #b6ffc8 top hairline and a 1px #1d6a38 bottom edge so it has the same enamel as an ElvUI status bar.

Character card upper stage is about 40 percent empty. Put the portrait 16px from the left, the speech 12px to its right, and shrink the stage to the portrait height plus 24px so the tidbit grid is not stranded in black.
state_colours: The clause more rest is wasted. is the same green as a healthy full bar. Keep Full since 1d 16h ago in #3dba6a and paint the waste clause #e2b34a so the reason to switch is not a success color.

Not-resting and resting are close on the short 20 percent versus 21 percent bars. Use #e23b3b for not resting and #e39a3c for resting, and thicken each row rail to 4px so the hue reads without the chip.
Timeline night columns still read slate blue, a fifth color. Fill them #141414 at 35 percent over the panel so only green, yellow, orange, and red carry state.
character_identity: Several names share a Le stem and the row meta never says the class. After the level, add the class at 12px in class color: Lv 6 · Warlock · Thunderbrew inn · 2d ago.
The card level disc sits on the face. Move 11 into the meta line and keep only a 20px class badge on a #1a120c disc with a 1px #c6a15a rim.
Give every row portrait a 2px class ring (warlock #8788EE, warrior #C69B6D, druid #FF7C0A, paladin #F48CBA) so identity holds when the badge is under 28px.
default_theme: Primary and secondary buttons are the same bronze as the frame. View details and Done: fill #6a4b24, 2px border #f0d78c, label #fff4d4. Compact, Unlink, All accounts: fill #2e2418, 1px border #8a7044, label #e4d5b4.
The close X is about 11px inside a 32px hit area and looks lighter than the frame rivets. Draw a 16px #f4ead4 X, optically centered, with a 1px #c6a15a rim.
Alternate rows #22180f on a #160f0b panel so seven bronze rows do not fuse; leave the state rail as the only saturated edge.
elvui_wc3_fit: The roster is a hairline on flat #0c0c0c while the character and options frames are thick ElvUI metal. Match that chrome: same border weight and gold as the options window, 8px corners, 12px content inset.
Alert title gold is yellower than ElvUI label gold. Use host gold #ffcc00 for wood titles and #cbb892 for the secondary line so toasts and the roster are one palette.
The blue Details button sits tight on the wood edge and looks pasted on. Inset it 12px from the right, 28px tall, vertically centered on the Next row, matching Compact.
alerts_ux: The logout banner and the inn card repeat the same hearth sentence. Banner title 16px #f3ead8: Cancel logout, then rest in an inn. One body line 13px #c9bba6: Le Jette is outside a rest area. Hearth to Feathermoon Stronghold. Delete the third line.
The Esc card uses the same three-line stack as the banner. Add a persistent 11px #e2b34a ESC label at its top left so the two do not read as duplicates.
Toast lines are one weight. Trigger 13px #e0a050, advice 16px #f4efe2 Play Le Dette, subline 13px #5dce86. Put a 3px state rail 6px in from the wood, in the color of the character who ran out.
readability: Row location and seen text is about 12px #8f846f. Raise it to 13px #cbbfa3, and set the ETA to 13px semibold #f0e2c4 so time-to-full wins the scan.
Then Le Bankken, full in 19h under the 1.5 is the faintest type in the hero. Make it 13px #e6d3a1.
Timeline axis labels (NOW, 12:00, 18:00, +48H) are under 11px on the night bands. Set them to 12px #d5c7a8.
layout_polish: In the timeline scene the Le Bankken hover card sits in the left margin, off the lane. Clamp tooltips inside the window, 8px from the cursor, and flip them before they cross the frame edge.
The card speech well is about twice the height of its two lines. Size the stage to the portrait (about 120px) plus 12px, then place the 2x2 tidbit grid 12px under the rest line.
The 1.5 stack is top-aligned against a 112px portrait. Center the number, LEVELS BANKED, and the runner-up as one group with 4px gaps.
delight: The card speech is a flat rectangle, so it reads as a system label. Add an 8px tail aimed at the portrait and set the line in 15px italic #f6edd8.
A full hero has no marker except the green bar. Add a 16px-tall pill at the right end of the bar: Full, fill #3a2e14, text #e2b34a. No animation.
The imp line is trapped in a tiny bubble. Repeat it under the hero name at 13px italic #d9cbb0 so the personality is on the surface you actually choose from.

overall_notes: Round 3 is a real step up: one button family per theme, Full since instead of Full for, colored badges, state-matched chips, a named runner-up, and a timeline that says who fills next. I would not sign it for a demanding user yet. The who-to-play answer is already excellent (hero, compact Next line, timeline heading), but the do-this line is the quietest text in the hero, more rest is wasted. is painted as success, the character card is a portrait floating in an empty well, and the default bronze buttons sink into the frame. Fix contrast, the card stage, and button weight before calling it shippable.
